# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by `python3 automation/supervisor/settings_view.py --docs`. Don't edit by hand: CI checks it. -->

Every setting the Boundroom supervisor reads, from the registry in `automation/supervisor/settings.py` ([SPEC-008](../architecture/plugin-settings.md)). Precedence, highest first: kill switch, flag, `BOUNDROOM_*` variable, legacy variable (read only when the new name is unset), the operator's file under `~/.config/boundroom/`, the repository, the default. A `narrow-only` repository value can only lower a setting.

To see the values in effect, run `python3 automation/supervisor/settings_view.py` (quick view), `--all`, `--json` or `--explain <id>`.

## Runner

| Setting | Class | Default | Flags | Variables | Repository | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `runner` | security | `auto` |  | `BOUNDROOM_AGENT_RUNNER, REPO_AUTOMATION_AGENT_RUNNER` |  | Which agent harness runs the slice; auto means the one the call came from. One of auto, codex, claude, hermes. |
| `claude_permission_mode` | security | `bypassPermissions` |  | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_PERMISSION_MODE, REPO_AUTOMATION_CLAUDE_PERMISSION_MODE` |  | The permission mode a Claude Code runner starts in. |
| `claude_profile` | security |  | `--runner-profile` | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_PROFILE` |  | The Claude Code runner profile. Unset keeps claude_permission_mode's behavior until RA-SET-010. One of parent, bounded, edits, unbounded, custom. |
| `claude_profile_ceiling` | security | computed |  | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_PROFILE_CEILING` |  | The most a Claude runner may get; edits by default, unbounded when the machine is declared isolated. One of bounded, edits, unbounded. |
| `claude_isolated` | security |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_ISOLATED` |  | 1 declares this run is in a container or VM, which lets the ceiling admit unbounded. |
| `claude_settings` | security |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_SETTINGS` |  | The operator's own Claude Code settings file, for the custom profile. |
| `codex_bin` | advanced | `codex` |  | `BOUNDROOM_CODEX_BIN, REPO_AUTOMATION_CODEX_BIN, OWLORY_CODEX_BIN` |  | The Codex executable. |
| `claude_bin` | advanced | `claude` |  | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_BIN, REPO_AUTOMATION_CLAUDE_BIN` |  | The Claude Code executable. |
| `hermes_bin` | advanced | `hermes` |  | `BOUNDROOM_HERMES_BIN, REPO_AUTOMATION_HERMES_BIN` |  | The Hermes executable. |
| `hermes_transport` | advanced | `oneshot` |  | `BOUNDROOM_HERMES_TRANSPORT, REPO_AUTOMATION_HERMES_TRANSPORT` |  | How run_agent.sh talks to Hermes. One of oneshot, stream-json. |
| `hermes_max_turns` | advanced |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_HERMES_MAX_TURNS, REPO_AUTOMATION_HERMES_MAX_TURNS` |  | A turn limit for a Hermes session; honoured on the stream-json transport only. |
| `hermes_python` | advanced | computed |  | `BOUNDROOM_HERMES_PYTHON, REPO_AUTOMATION_HERMES_PYTHON` |  | The Hermes interpreter for the sandbox probe; defaults to the one beside the Hermes executable. |
| `hermes_usage_dir` | advanced |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_HERMES_USAGE_DIR, REPO_AUTOMATION_HERMES_USAGE_DIR` |  | Where a Hermes session's usage and controls report is written. |
| `hermes_sandbox_image` | security |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_HERMES_SANDBOX_IMAGE, REPO_AUTOMATION_HERMES_SANDBOX_IMAGE` |  | The container image Hermes runs its tools in. |

## Work source

| Setting | Class | Default | Flags | Variables | Repository | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queue` | essential | `automation/queue/slices.json` | `--queue` |  |  | The JSON queue slices come from, when no board is given. |
| `board` | essential |  | `--board, --kanban-board` |  | `overlay.board (any)` | The Kanban board directory slices come from, instead of the queue. |
| `kanban_overlay` | essential |  | `--kanban-overlay` |  |  | The approval overlay for the board. |
| `board_backend` | essential | `hermes` | `--board-backend` |  | `overlay.backend (any)` | The board's kind; defaults to the overlay's backend and must match it. One of hermes, local. |
| `hermes_command` | advanced | `hermes` | `--hermes` |  |  | The command that runs the Hermes CLI, for writes to a Hermes board. |
| `handoff_dir` | advanced | `automation/handoffs` | `--handoff-dir` |  |  | Where handoff artifacts are expected. |
| `include_blocked` | advanced | `false` | `--include-blocked` |  |  | Report blocked and deferred slices when none is eligible. |
| `dry_run` | advanced | `false` | `--dry-run` |  |  | Decide without launching an agent or changing the queue. |

## Policy

| Setting | Class | Default | Flags | Variables | Repository | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `single_slice` | security | `false` | `--single-slice` |  |  | Run at most one slice, refusing any autonomous limit. |
| `autonomous_limit` | security |  | `--autonomous-limit` |  | `queue.policy.consecutive_autonomous_limit, overlay.policy.consecutive_autonomous_limit (any)` | How many slices may run back to back unattended; the policy value is a default a caller can override. |
| `agent_command` | security |  | `--agent-cmd` |  | `queue.policy.agent_command_template, overlay.policy.agent_command_template (any)` | The shell command template that launches the agent. |
| `supervisor_owned_paths` | security |  |  |  | `queue.policy.supervisor_owned_paths, overlay.policy.supervisor_owned_paths (any)` | Files no slice may change. |
| `handoff_timeout_seconds` | advanced |  |  |  | `queue.policy.handoff_timeout_seconds, overlay.policy.handoff_timeout_seconds (any)` | How long the supervisor waits for an agent's handoff. |

## Telemetry

| Setting | Class | Default | Flags | Variables | Repository | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `telemetry_kill_switch` | security | `false` | `--no-telemetry` |  |  | Turn telemetry off whatever any other source says; BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY=off does the same. |
| `telemetry_mode` | security | `off` | `--telemetry` | `BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY` | `queue.policy.telemetry.mode, overlay.policy.telemetry.mode (narrow-only); operator telemetry.json:mode` | off, file or otlp. Telemetry is on only with a mode and a destination. One of off, file, otlp. |
| `telemetry_file_dir` | security |  | `--telemetry-file-dir` | `BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY_FILE_DIR` | `operator telemetry.json:file_dir` | Where file mode writes its JSON Lines; an absolute directory outside the repository. |
| `telemetry_endpoint` | security |  | `--telemetry-endpoint` | `BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT` | `operator telemetry.json:endpoint` | Your OTLP endpoint; https://, or http:// to localhost only. |
| `telemetry_headers` | secret | `{}` |  | `BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY_HEADERS` | `operator telemetry.json:headers` | Headers sent only to the endpoint, such as a token. Never a flag, never printed. |
| `telemetry_capture` | security | `metadata` | `--telemetry-capture` | `BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY_CAPTURE` | `queue.policy.telemetry.capture, overlay.policy.telemetry.capture (narrow-only); operator telemetry.json:capture` | metadata, or content as well. One of metadata, content. |
| `telemetry_runner` | security | `off` | `--telemetry-runner` | `BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY_RUNNER` | `queue.policy.telemetry.runner, overlay.policy.telemetry.runner (narrow-only); operator telemetry.json:runner` | Whether the runner's own telemetry joins the trace. One of off, metadata, content. |
| `telemetry_required` | advanced | `false` | `--telemetry-required` | `BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY_REQUIRED` | `operator telemetry.json:required` | Refuse to start a run whose telemetry can't be enabled. |
| `telemetry_environment` | advanced | `local` |  | `BOUNDROOM_TELEMETRY_ENVIRONMENT` | `queue.policy.telemetry.environment, overlay.policy.telemetry.environment (any); operator telemetry.json:environment` | A short name recorded on every span, such as local, ci or benchmark. |

## Set by Boundroom, not by you

| Setting | Class | Default | Flags | Variables | Repository | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `supervisor_context_file` | internal |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_SUPERVISOR_CONTEXT_FILE, REPO_AUTOMATION_SUPERVISOR_CONTEXT_FILE, OWLORY_SUPERVISOR_CONTEXT_FILE` |  | Exported to the agent: its context bundle. |
| `supervisor_handoff_file` | internal |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_SUPERVISOR_HANDOFF_FILE, REPO_AUTOMATION_SUPERVISOR_HANDOFF_FILE, OWLORY_SUPERVISOR_HANDOFF_FILE` |  | Exported to the agent: where it writes its handoff. |
| `supervisor_slice_id` | internal |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_SUPERVISOR_SLICE_ID, REPO_AUTOMATION_SUPERVISOR_SLICE_ID, OWLORY_SUPERVISOR_SLICE_ID` |  | Exported to the agent: the slice it is running. |
| `claude_runner_mode` | internal |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_RUNNER_MODE` |  | Set for run_agent.sh: the permission mode the chosen profile resolved to. |
| `claude_runner_settings` | internal |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_RUNNER_SETTINGS` |  | Set for run_agent.sh: the per-slice settings file, outside the repository. |
| `claude_runner_budget_usd` | internal | `5` |  | `BOUNDROOM_CLAUDE_RUNNER_BUDGET_USD` |  | Set for run_agent.sh: the per-slice budget cap. |
| `sandbox_probe_command` | internal | `pwd && test -x ./executable && test -d .git` |  | `BOUNDROOM_SANDBOX_PROBE_COMMAND, REPO_AUTOMATION_SANDBOX_PROBE_COMMAND` |  | Diagnostic: the command the sandbox probe runs. |
| `sandbox_probe_barrier` | internal |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_SANDBOX_PROBE_BARRIER` |  | Diagnostic: the sandbox probe's barrier directory. |
| `sandbox_probe_barrier_seconds` | internal | `15` |  | `BOUNDROOM_SANDBOX_PROBE_BARRIER_SECONDS` |  | Diagnostic: how long the sandbox probe waits at its barrier. |
| `unlisted_sentinel` | internal |  |  | `BOUNDROOM_UNLISTED_SENTINEL` |  | Test hook: a variable the benchmark must not pass to an agent. |

## Classes

- **security: always in the quick view**
- **essential: in the quick view when its skill applies**
- **secret: never shown, only set or not set**
- **advanced: extensive view only**
- **internal: set by Boundroom for the agent**
- **outside the plugin**
